With over 25+ years of industry experience and 150+ successfully completed projects, Atharva Decorators is a trusted name in civil repairs, waterproofing, and painting solutions. We are trusted by 35,000+ world-class brands and organizations of all sizes

A second-generation entrepreneur, Avinash Deshmukh carries forward a legacy of excellence started by his father, Mr. Parshuram Deshmukh. After graduating in Chemistry in 1998, he gained hands-on experience in painting and project execution before founding Atharva Decorators in 2001. Guided by innovation, integrity, and quality, he continues to transform spaces across Maharashtra.
